computed_scope: leading potential-slow-roll background export at independently supplied N_star values only

declared_model_and_units.pivot_definition: N_star is an independent input to the potential-slow-roll integral N(phi_star)=integral_phi_end^phi_star V/V_prime dphi; it is not Phase19 N_acc and does not identify a bounce trajectory or reheating map
declared_model_and_units.root_convention: solve the monotone t=exp(alpha phi)>t_end form with bounded bracketing and absolute residual <=1e-11
declared_model_and_units.slow_roll_definitions: epsilon_V=(1/2)(V_prime/V)^2, eta_V=V_double_prime/V, H_star=sqrt(V_star/3), P_R=V_star/(24*pi^2*epsilon_V), P_T=2*H_star^2/pi^2, n_s=1-6*epsilon_V+2*eta_V, r=16*epsilon_V

exact_checks.statement: The N primitive is (3/4)(t-log t), with t=exp(alpha phi).
All exported quantities use the declared reduced-Planck convention; no observational normalization is inferred.

numerical_checks.statement: The bounded monotone pivot root satisfies its declared N_star equation.
The exported H_star satisfies 3H_star^2=V_star within floating residual.
The exported leading spectra obey P_T/P_R=r within floating residual.
